title: Jake Barber's psionic assets locking onto craft

tellings.quote: thing which is uh I know Jake Barber is obviously a source for Ross

plain: A man named Jake Barber is said to describe 'psionic assets', people who use their minds in a psychic way, who could lock onto unknown craft. Michels brings this up on the show and notes that Barber is a source for the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, the hidden programme would be using minds as well as machines to find these craft.
